subject: organic
question:
有机化学·保护基化学：下列哪组反应条件能够脱除所示保护基：Benzyl ether（benzyl ether）？
A. H₂, Pd/C
B. Pd(PPh₃)₄, PhSiH₃
C. Piperidine, DMF
D. TFA, CH₂Cl₂
explanation: A robust ether that survives acid and base; hydrogenolysis (H₂, Pd/C) or dissolving metal removes it.
